name: place_chutes
summary: Lay a chute run, or pieces, from Kit (Chute) as a player builds it, from the source to the sink; straights, corners and junctions, with flow guards. Dry run by default; confirm to build.

help.text: Items travel from the run's first cell to its last: start at the source (a device's Output port, a chute bin, a line carrying items toward it) and end at the sink (an Input port, a line carrying them away). The run forms, joins, dry run, job and materials are place_cables', with kits (not_enough_kits). Each cell reports flow {in, out}. A piece with an item riding in it is never altered or removed (cannot_change).

pieces.text: A straight or corner (1 kit each), or where three ends meet in a T a junction (2 kits) turned so its output faces downstream. Four ends or a corner of three is no_piece_for_ends. Long straights, windows, valves, overflows, splitters, bins, inlets and outlets are never placed.

flow.text: A straight or corner passes an item out of the end it did not come in by; a junction takes items through its two inputs and lets them out only through its output; an Input port takes items off the chute, an Output port pushes them in; a rocket chute umbilical's port carries items both ways. flow_reversed: what the run joins pushes against its direction (reverse the waypoints). flow_conflict: flows meet head-on, or an item would enter through an output (a junction merges, it cannot split). flow_ambiguous: nothing fixes which way a junction faces. Warnings: drops_items (items would fall out of an open end), flow_unknown.

remove_ids.description: Chute pieces removed in the same job before building (see runs/assume_removed).

reference_id.description: A device or piece on the network.

join_to.description: The chute network the run must end up on (see runs/taps).

from_id.description: The thing whose inventory gives the coils or kits and takes the refund. Default the player.

refund.description: Give back what removed pieces and cheaper changes return. Default true; false is refund_to none.

limit.description: Cells listed; default 5, 0 for none. All are counted and checked.
